int4_config.scheme: K=per-channel INT4, V=per-token INT4, asymmetric, k_group=32, v_group=32

verdict: **INCONCLUSIVE.** MMLU-delta spread 1.30pt across sinks is within the 2σ binomial noise band (±4.10pt at 1000 questions) — the sink configurations are statistically indistinguishable; and the sweep is non-monotonic (a non-zero sink scores worse than the no-sink control), confirming no clean recovery mechanism. The §20.2 hypothesis (sink-FP16 recovers the −0.9pt gap) is neither confirmed nor refuted — INT4 KV quality is within measurement noise of FP16, and no sink-FP16 recovery mechanism is resolved. A decisive test needs ~4-5× more questions (~5000) to shrink the CI below the effect size. Report as tested-inconclusive, not as a quality win.
